title: Appointment Booking and Reminder Voice Agent
summary: A Hindi, English and regional-language voice agent that books, reschedules and cancels OPD appointments against live doctor schedules and calls patients with reminders.

seo.title: Hospital Appointment Booking Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: Voice agent that books OPD appointments against live HIS slots in Hindi, English and regional languages, sends reminders and hands urgent calls to staff.

designed_for: Head of Patient Services and Front Office

problem.intro: Hospital phone lines are busiest in the morning, when callers want a slot with a particular doctor and the front desk is also registering walk-in patients. Missed calls become lost appointments, and booked patients forget or arrive on the wrong day when a doctor's OPD changes.

pain_points.title: Missed and abandoned calls
pain_points.detail: Peak-hour calls go unanswered, and patients book elsewhere or turn up as walk-ins.

pain_points.title: Complex schedules
pain_points.detail: Doctors run OPD on different days, with separate slots for new and follow-up patients, procedures and teleconsultations.

pain_points.title: No-shows and late cancellations
pain_points.detail: Without reminders, slots go unused while other patients wait days for an appointment.

pain_points.title: Doctor leave and OPD changes
pain_points.detail: When a consultant cancels OPD, staff must phone every booked patient by hand.

solution.overview: We build a voice agent that answers appointment calls in Hindi, English and the regional languages your patients speak. It reads live slots from your HIS scheduling module, understands requests such as the next available slot with a cardiologist on Saturday, and books, reschedules or cancels appointments. Existing patients are found by mobile number or UHID, and new patients are registered with the minimum details your process needs. The agent sends a WhatsApp or SMS confirmation, calls with a reminder before the visit and phones booked patients when a doctor's OPD is cancelled. It gives no medical advice; callers who describe urgent symptoms are directed to emergency care and transferred to staff.
capabilities: Speech recognition tuned for doctor names, departments and dates and times in Indian languages
Live slot lookup and booking against the HIS scheduling module
Existing-patient lookup by mobile number or UHID and minimal new-patient registration
Reminder calls and WhatsApp confirmations with reschedule options
Bulk rescheduling calls when a doctor's OPD changes
Emergency phrase detection that directs callers to emergency care and transfers to staff

workflow.title: Answer and understand
workflow.detail: The agent answers in the caller's language and identifies the request: book, reschedule, cancel or query.

workflow.title: Screen for urgency
workflow.detail: If the caller describes urgent symptoms, it gives scripted emergency guidance and transfers to staff at once.

workflow.title: Identify the patient
workflow.detail: Existing patients are found by mobile number or UHID; new patients are registered with minimal details.

workflow.title: Offer and confirm a slot
workflow.detail: It reads live availability, offers the nearest options, writes the booking to the HIS and confirms by WhatsApp or SMS.

workflow.title: Remind and reschedule
workflow.detail: Before the visit it calls with a reminder and handles changes, and it calls patients when an OPD is cancelled.

workflow.title: Hand over when needed
workflow.detail: Complaints and complex requests go to front-office staff with a call summary.

inputs: Doctor schedules and slot rules from the HIS
Patient registry with mobile numbers and UHIDs
Emergency phrase list and scripted guidance approved by clinicians
outputs: Booked, rescheduled and cancelled appointments in the HIS
human_in_the_loop: Front-office staff take escalated calls and complaints, and clinicians approve the emergency phrase list and scripted guidance. The agent never advises on symptoms or treatment; it books, reminds and hands over.
integrations: Cloud telephony such as Exotel, Ozonetel or Twilio
guardrails: No medical advice; scripted response and transfer whenever symptoms are described
Emergency phrases trigger immediate direction to emergency care and a staff transfer
Patient identity confirmed before any appointment is read or changed
Outbound calls only within permitted hours and to patients who booked or consented
Recordings and transcripts kept per hospital policy with restricted access
compliance_notes: Reminder calls and messages are service communications; any promotional content needs separate consent and TRAI-compliant channels.
Patient contact and appointment data handled under the DPDP Act 2023, with a recording notice at the start of each call.

pilot.scope: Inbound booking calls and reminders for three to five OPD departments during set hours, with an instant route to front-office staff.
deliverables: Call flows and scripts approved by front office and clinicians
Voice agent integrated with HIS scheduling, first in test and then live

what_we_measure.how: Bookings, reschedules and cancellations handled end to end by the agent.
Audit of agent-made bookings for the right patient, doctor, date and slot.
Compared with similar appointments booked before the pilot.
Short post-call feedback and supervisor review of transferred calls.

faqs.q: What if a caller describes an emergency?
faqs.a: The agent recognises emergency phrases from a list your clinicians approve, tells the caller to seek emergency care and transfers to staff immediately. It does not assess symptoms.

Hindi, English and Hinglish by default, with regional languages such as Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil or Bengali added to match your patient mix. We test recognition of doctor names and dates in each language before go-live.

faqs.q: Does it work with our HIS?
faqs.a: It needs read and write access to appointment slots and patient registration, usually through an API or database integration. If your HIS has no API, we work through an integration layer agreed with your vendor.
It can send a payment link by WhatsApp or SMS for prepaid slots if your process uses them. It never takes card or UPI details over the call.
